title: Chapter 6463: You?

Chapter 6463: You?

Chapter 6463: You?

It appeared Earthsplitter and Rising didn’t know what the crowd did regarding Li Qiye. He still sat down leisurely as if he was relaxing in his garden. Their powers affected him less than a slight breeze.

The two exchanged glances and knew the man was unfathomable.

“We are here for the golden spring.” Earthsplitter said.

“Wow, me too.” Li Qiye waved dismissively: “The spring has nothing to do with you two, return to the real world.”

He acted as if he were chasing away a dog, not bothering to look at them. His attitude naturally infuriated both, especially Earthsplitter given her prestigious status.

As for the crowd, they couldn’t think about anything since they were stricken with fear. Normally, meeting primal ancestors was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity - a great honor.

However, given the circumstances, this was most likely a disaster, not an honor. This could be their last day in the blink of an eye.

“If the golden spring belongs to the dream world, everyone deserves a share.” Earthsplitter said, not wanting to give it up.

“Amitabha, I only wish to have one scoop of the spring.” Rising had no intention of yielding.

As primal ancestors in Old World, they knew a particular secret - the origin of the dream world was Heavenly Sin Ground.

The broken realm shattered into Uncrossable Expanse. The pieces disappeared and couldn’t be found by anyone including primal ancestors and heaven-slayers.

It potentially contained immortal-level treasures and fortunes.. When the dream appeared, they knew this came from the immortal’s broken home.

This applied to the golden spring as well; its source must be from the immortal. Obtaining this source meant a chance to reach the supreme overlord realm.

Although they understood Li Qiye was unfathomable, the temptation was too much.

“Looks like tears only fall when the coffins are there.” Li Qiye said: “Being unwise right now is courting death.”

Their expression darkened upon hearing.

“I would like to see what you can do.” Earthsplitter had a fiery temperament.

“You? Seeing that you have some charm, I am merciful enough to spare you. Don’t be stubborn and invite destruction.” Li Qiye said.

The crowd became frozen since he spoke so trivially toward a primal ancestor. However, they recalled how Luosha and Ocean-gaze Ancestor had kneeled to him previously.

“Amitabha, you are rather aggressive, Fellow Daoist.” Rising didn’t appreciate being treated like an ant and wanted to give it a shot. He had too much pride as a primal ancestor to just run away.

“I will oblige if you two want to die, let’s see what you can do.” Li Qiye said while still sun bathing on his chair.

“Amitabha.” Rising placed his palms together, gathering the power of countless Buddhas.

“Boom!” A great golden storm manifested into reality as Earthsplitter focused her gaze.

Gold Village trembled from just them channeling their power.

“Boom!” In another corner of Gold Village, three trees unleashed their torrential power.

“What’s going on?!” The impact alarmed all existences including Earthsplitter and Rising.

“Heavenscorch!” Iron-spear shouted while releasing a draconic inferno incinerating the sky.

“Iron-spear Ancestor!” Everyone was amazed by the sheer devastation caused by his attack.

The second combatant was none other than Ocean-gaze Ancestor who used a bowl.
